title_en: Famous Chinese People (16/20): Qian Xuesen, Father of China's Space Program
note_en: The character 为 has two readings. As wèi it means "for, on behalf of" and comes before the person or cause served: 为祖国的科学事业服务 "to serve his country's science." As wéi it means "to be, as," and it follows verbs like 任命 "appoint" and 当选 "elect": 他被任命为国防部第五研究院院长 "he was appointed director of the Fifth Academy." Watch the position: wèi goes before a noun and the main verb, wéi right after a verb.
